fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After systematic learning and meeting graduation requirements, students will be awarded MBBS degree. Students will be given the bachelor's degree of medicine if they pass the graduation exam (including exam on medical knowledge and exam on clinical skills) . The program pays much attention to cultivating clinicians who have profound professional integrity, solid ground of basic medicine and systematic knowledge of clinical medicine and have acquired basic clinical skills as well as the ability to deal with problems in clinical settings. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: There are foundamental, basic medical and clinical courses in this program. 2.1 Main Courses human anatomy, histoembryology, physiology, cytology and biochemistry, medical genetics, immunology, pathogenic biology, pathology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, diagnostics, internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, traditional Chinese medicine, psychiatry, etc. 2.2 Teaching Arrangement for MBBS 2.3 Credit Requirements The students should complete 203.5 credits, among which premed pubic courses are 26.5 credits, basic medical courses 48.5 credits and clinical medical courses 54.5 credits. The clinical rotation makes 74 credits. 2.4 Internship and Career Internship: Tongji University has 5 affiliated hospitals (t he duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks) : Tongji hospital, Shanghai No. 10 People's Hospital, East Hospital, Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Health Hospital. Notes: These are all high level hospitals and have 4,443 beds altogether. Students must take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in WHU. Career: The graduates will be able to apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council to get registered and practice medicine, when they obtain MBBS Degree. Students have to do the degree accreditation first because of the regulations in different countries. Students who obtain MBBS degree can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Students can also open his own clinic or continuely study for master's degree. 3. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: Students will be given a medical degree by Tongji University. MBBS Degree : Students who meet the requirements of the teaching program and pass the graduation examinations successfully will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the Tongji University. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: Tongji University has been included in the State-founded Project 211 and the 21st Century Education Rejuvenation Action Plan of China. After the establishment of the People's Republic of China in 1949, Tongji University became an engineering university following a nationwide restructuring of institutions of higher learning in 1952. It was the largest university of civil engineering and offered the most specialized engineering programs in China. The university has developed rapidly into a multidisciplinary university featuring sciences, engineering, economics, management, liberal arts and law, with the initiation of the open up policy under the authorization of the central government in 1978 , Learn More>> 5. The Medical School Editor Notes: Tongji University began recruiting foreign students since the 1950s. ​ The Medical School has cooperated with University of Leipzig, University of Phillip-Marburg. Student exchange has been carried out with Paris V, University of Ulm, University of Leipzig and University of Phillip-Marburg on. Three high-level cardiology workshops have been co-organized by American Cardiology College and the Medical School have. The Medical School has been authorized as the high-qualified university to offer MBBS program in English. 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Admission priority will be given to applicants who can provide letters of recommendation. 2. Admission priority will be given to applicants holding New HSK Level 4 Certificates * 3. Personal statement Please write your introduction according to the personal statement template (undergraduate) in the teaching language of the professional program (for example, the statementfor a program taught in Chinese should be written in Chinese, and the statement for aprogram taught in English should be written in English). You can download a template or sample from here . 4. Admission priority will be given to applicants who can provide other supporting materials e.g. award certificates, foreign entrance examination transcripts, university admission notice, etc. * 5. A Chinese Name You can create a Chinese name for yourself, write it in document and upload here since it is necessary for applying to Tongji University. If you didn't upload or fill in application form, then we will have to create a Chinese name for you. You may communicate with teacher to change it later though. * 6. Physical Health Report (in the last six months). * 7. Personal information page of the passport(Passport valid until March 1, 2027 and beyond) * 8. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 9. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 10. Original or notarized transcripts of all courses in high school For a transcript in a language other than Chinese and English, the original notarized copy of the Chinese or English translation must be provided. The notarized copy must be issued by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad, or a foreign embassy and consulate in China; We recommend that you attach a description of the evaluation criteria of the transcripts. The results of the national senior high school entrance examination or the internationally accepted test results of the country of origin, such as UEC/A Level/AP/IB/SAT/ACT, can also be submitted as supplementary materials. * 11. High school diploma For a certificate in a language other than Chinese and English, the original notarized copy of the Chinese or English translation must be provided. The notarized copy must be issued by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad, or a foreign embassy or consulate in China; The original graduation certificate issued by the school of a new high school graduate needs to be provided. Upon admission, you need to bring the original high school graduation certificate for verification during registration; For a Malaysian SPM diploma, the certificate of completion of one-year preparatory studies and transcript of the preparatory courses are also required. * 12. Copy of English proficiency certificate IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL IBT 85 or above. The original certificate is required to be submitted at the registration, if the student is admitted.(Applicants who are native English-speakers or have studied in English-medium high schools are not required to submit English proficiency certificates.) * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. - For MBBS program: the required subjects are Mathematics and Chemistry — the test papers need to be in English. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants should be between18-35 years old(No later than Dec.31st of that year,Dec.31st included.),high school graduate or above, non-Chinese citizen with non-criminal record, in good health and with a good command of English (IELTS6.5/TOEFLIBT 85 or above). Applicants who are native English-speakers or have studied in English-taught high schools are not required to submit English proficiency certificates. The No.12 Document of 2020 issued by the Ministry of Education, PRC is administered by the University. Two important items of the Document are to note. First, according to Article 5 of Nationality Law of The People's Republic of China,‘a person whose parents are both Chinese nationals and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese national and has settled abroad, and who has acquired foreign nationality at birth shall not have Chinese nationality. Since 2021, those applying to study at universities or junior colleges as international students, should satisfy the following additional requirements: the applicants must hold valid foreign passport or other relevant international recognized documents for at least 4 years; meanwhile,in the latest 4 years(by each April 30th of the year of University registration), the applicants must live overseas for 2 years(Living overseas for 9 months can be converted to 1 year, which is subject to the exit-entry stamp on visa.). Second, those who immigrated to other countries from the Mainland China,HongKong, Macao or Taiwan and apply to study as international students at universities or junior colleges of China are required to satisfy the requirement of the first item. If the applicant is under the age of 18 before 31st August of the application year, the guardian is required to provide supplementary materials. See"IV. Application Materials" for details. For students applying for MBBS, the subjects of the CSCA exam you need to take are Mathematics and Chemistry (the test papers are in English).
